title: A simple analytical method for the simultaneous determination of multiple organic pollutants in sediment samples
author: Zeng, Hu, et al.

steps.title: Spike sediment and Soxhlet extract
steps.instruction: Weigh approximately 10 g of dry sediment, spike with 50 ng of each surrogate standard (d8‑Nap, d10‑Ace, d10‑Phe, d12‑Chr, d12‑Per, d27‑TNBP, d15‑TPHP, d12‑TCEP, d15‑MX) and add activated copper to remove elemental sulfur; then perform a Soxhlet extraction with 200 mL dichloromethane for 72 h.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 ng of each surrogate standard (d8‑Nap, d10‑Ace, d10‑Phe, d12‑Chr, d12‑Per, d27‑TNBP, d15‑TPHP, d12‑TCEP, d15‑MX).
Add activated copper to the sample to bind elemental sulfur.
Soxhlet‑extract the spiked sediment with 200 mL CH₂Cl₂ for 72 h.

steps.title: Concentrate extract and solvent exchange
steps.instruction: Reduce the Soxhlet extract with a rotary evaporator to about 1 mL, exchange the solvent to n‑hexane, and reconcentrate to a final volume of approximately 1 mL.

substeps.instruction: Re‑evaporate to a final volume of ~1 mL.

steps.title: Pack chromatographic column
steps.instruction: Prepare a glass column (0.8 cm i.d. × 30 cm) with a Teflon stopcock, then sequentially pack neutral alumina, silica gel (1:2 alumina:silica ratio), and anhydrous Na₂SO₄.

substeps.instruction: Set up a glass column (0.8 cm inner diameter, 30 cm length) with a Teflon stopcock.
Pack neutral alumina into the column.
Pack silica gel on top of the alumina in a 1:2 alumina‑to‑silica ratio.
Add a layer of anhydrous Na₂SO₄ on top.

steps.title: Load extract and elute fractions
steps.instruction: Load the final extract onto the packed column, first wash with 15 mL n‑hexane (discarded), then collect three fractions using specified solvent mixtures and volumes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the ~1 mL final extract onto the column using 15 mL n‑hexane; discard this wash (no target compounds).
Collect Fraction 1 with 50 mL n‑hexane/CH₂Cl₂ (3:1, v/v) to elute PAHs, DDTs, HCHs, MA and MX.
Collect Fraction 2 with 60 mL n‑hexane/CH₂Cl₂ (1:1, v/v) for polycyclic musks, MK and UV filters.
Collect Fraction 3 with 100 mL ethyl acetate (EtOAc) for organophosphorus compounds (OPs).

steps.title: Analyze samples and QA/QC
steps.instruction: Analyze the four sediment samples together with QA/QC sets: three solvent blanks, three spiked blanks, and three spiked matrix samples, using the same analytical procedure as for the real samples.

substeps.instruction: Prepare four sediment extracts for analysis.
Prepare QA/QC samples: 3 solvent blanks, 3 spiked blanks (standards in solvent), and 3 spiked matrix samples (standards added to pre‑extracted sediment).
Analyze all samples under identical instrumental conditions.
